reports.notes: Handwritten cursive. This is the UNDATED-YEAR version of the legacy form (title has no year and cites 'Utah County Code 2-5-2'), unlike the other 2010 filings in this chunk. COLUMN B (Year-to-Date) IS ENTIRELY BLANK on lines 1 and 2 - the filer left both cells empty, so contrib_cumulative and expend_cumulative are '' and are NOT zero. No cents are written anywhere on this summary page: the filer wrote whole dollars only (750, 1,502, 1502, -752) - transcribed verbatim, no '.00' added. Line 2 is written with a thousands comma ('1,502') and line 6 without one ('1502'); both kept as printed. Line 3 is a plain '0'. LINE 7 reads as a minus sign followed by the filer's dollar-sign glyph and '752' ('-$752'); the leading glyph is the same one he uses on lines 1/4/5/6, so it is read as a dollar sign and the value as -752, at medium confidence - if that glyph were a digit the value would instead be -8752. No arithmetic was used to choose between them beyond noting the glyph shape matches. AMENDMENT: neither 'Yes' nor 'No' is checked, so is_amendment is ''. The signature date is written '8 May 10' with a trailing apostrophe; the clerk's FILED stamp (upside-down on the scan) reads '10 MAY 21 PM 4:15'. office_index 'County Surveyor' agrees with the page. candidate_index was blank; the page names Scott M Peterson.

THE CORRECTION IS CONFIRMED BY THE ARITHMETIC, not merely by the glyph: a 900 dpi crop of pct:76,78.5,20,8@p3 rendered BOTH bottom-of-page cells as a struck '4' with a '7' written above it followed by '50.00', and only the corrected reading (750.00) matches the rows and the cover. The exact closure also settles two cells whose glyphs are individually soft on this washed-out scan — row 8's 362.42 and row 11's 38.48 — since no other reading of either reaches 1,502.00 (GOTCHAS: arithmetic closure outranks glyph reading, and here it is UNIQUE rather than ambiguous). itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'Scott M Peterson' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 county_static listing grouped filings by office), so the page face governs and is offered to the coordinator for promotion into that EMPTY channel cell. Office Seeking 'County Surveyor'; party 'Republican'; residence city Springville, UT (street line printed unredacted on the cover and deliberately not carried). 4 pages, each classified from its OWN printed header: p1 COVER, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. Report type '30 Days after withdraw or elimination' — the FIRST box on the form and the only filing in this chunk to use it, consistent with a candidate who left the race before the Primary. Signed '8 May 10' (the filer's own apostrophe after the year is part of his hand). THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither Yes nor No ticked; an honest BLANK, never read as 'No' (Addendum A4). ~ THE TEMPLATE-VINTAGE PROPERTY GAINS AN EARLIER 2010 INSTANCE. This filing is on the UNDATED blank — its title is bare 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with NO year, and it cites 'Utah County Code 2-5-2' — while the other four 2010 filings in this chunk (Campbell, Tracy and both Ratcliffe reports) are on the '2010 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT' blank citing 'Code 2-5'. Addendum A4 records the undated 2-5-2 blank on Poulson's DECEMBER 2010 filing and reads it as a late-cycle switch; this MAY 2010 filing shows the two templates were in circulation SIMULTANEOUSLY from early in the cycle, so template vintage orders nothing in time and must never be used to date or sequence a filing. ~ THE CLERK'S FILED STAMP IS PRINTED UPSIDE-DOWN at the foot of the cover — 'FILED UTAH COUNTY / 10 MAY 21 PM 4:15 / CLERK' reads inverted, the sheet having been stamped or fed rotated. It gives a receipt date of 21 May 2010 against the filer's own signature date of 8 May 2010, a 13-day gap; both are kept verbatim and neither is corrected. The county's channel period label ('Peterson - 5/21/10') follows the stamp, not the signature. ~ FOLIATION: 'Page 1 of 1' on each of pages 2, 3 and 4 independently — the Tracy convention seen elsewhere in this chunk, and a third distinct convention from Ratcliffe's '2/3/4 of 4'. This filer also writes his FULL name, 'Scott M Peterson', into the box printed 'Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name' on all three sheets. ~ A LARGE CURVED PHOTOCOPY ARTIFACT crosses Schedule A: a single sweeping ink-black line loops down the empty lower two-thirds of the page and around the Subtotal area, and smaller versions run along the left edge of every page together with a heavy black border. It carries no text, touches no entry, and is a copier/platen artifact rather than a strike-out or a void mark — the band-4 control crop rendered it as a bare curve over an empty ruled line. It is also why the full-width rule scan fails and the --col recovery was needed. ~ BOTH SIDES CLOSE EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A: contributions 750.00 (after the filer's own 450-to-750 correction, which the row sum independently confirms) and expenditures 1,502.00, leaving the real negative closing balance of -752.00 that line 7 prints.
